detections.sql:
SELECT p.category, p.sku, p.style_name, i.stock_count, i.reorder_point 
FROM products p 
JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku 
WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point AND i.stock_count > 0.5 * i.reorder_point
detections.insight: The data indicates a high risk of stockouts across the Outerwear category, with 9 out of 10 products having a stock count below the reorder point. This suggests a potential operational risk, as customers may be unable to purchase these products when they need them. Furthermore, the fact that 7 out of 10 products in this category have a stock count above 50% of the reorder point indicates that the current inventory levels are not optimized, leading to potential waste and unnecessary holding costs.
detections.recommendation: To mitigate this risk, I recommend that the executive: 1. **Conduct an immediate review of the inventory management process** to identify the root cause of the stockouts and optimize inventory levels across the Outerwear category. This may involve adjusting reorder points, lead times, or supplier agreements. 2. **Implement a just-in-time (JIT) inventory replenishment strategy** to ensure that products are replenished just in time to meet customer demand, reducing the risk of stockouts and waste.
